calls.title: Grupo Supley + GrowthBook
calls.summary: Grupo Supply, a well-established wellness product seller in Brazil, is looking to enhance its e-commerce decision-making by implementing a robust A/B testing platform. Their current system is limited, relying on time-based comparisons that are affected by market fluctuations and unrelated website issues, resulting in uncertain conversion data. They explored GrowthBook, an open-source platform that integrates well with existing analytics tools like Google Analytics and BigQuery. The company plans to trial this cloud-hosted solution for two weeks while discussing pricing and seeking a Portuguese version of the UI to improve user accessibility.
calls.keywords: A/B Testing, GrowthBook, BigQuery, Google Analytics, Experimentation Platform, Feature Flags
